notes:
User is organizing several collections: coins, vinyl records, vintage cameras, and books.

- Coin collection:
  - Considering **Coin Collector’s Assistant** for cataloging.
  - Owns a **1913 Liberty Head nickel** and wants reputable appraisal/authentication; suggested major services include PCGS, NGC, ANA, and PNG experts/dealers.
  - Has **37 pre-1920 American coins** and wants to organize them by denomination and mint mark, then display all 37 together.
  - Recently added a **1915-S Barber quarter**.
  - Owns a **1972 doubled die Lincoln cent** and plans to submit it soon to PCGS or NGC for authentication/grading. PCGS may be more popular among error-coin collectors, but user is willing to consider either and will review submission guidelines first.
  - Interested in error coins, especially misprinted dates. Values reliable identification, checking details against reputable references, and third-party authentication because such coins may be altered, counterfeited, or incorrectly attributed.
  - Interested in recommendations for coin cases or albums large enough for 37 coins. Prioritize reputable numismatic products, accurate dimensions/capacity, good condition, archival/inert materials, secure closure, attractive display, and protection from handling, dust, moisture, and tampering.
  - Plans to use the **ANA calendar** and **CoinShowCalendar** to find upcoming coin shows, and also plans to check local dealers, forums, and social groups. Has not provided geographic location.
  - Important collecting care: handle coins by the edges with clean, dry hands; do not use cotton gloves for coins. Use PVC-free holders, appropriate 2×2 flips if storing slabs, and never clean/polish an old coin. Maintain stable, moderate temperature and low humidity, and avoid prolonged direct sunlight.
  - For valuable coins, distinguish informal opinion/appraisal from formal third-party grading, authentication, or insurance appraisal.

- Record collection:
  - Plans to use **Discogs** to catalog vinyl records.
  - Likely useful features: format, label/catalog number, pressing/reissue details, matrix/runout information, artist/album, edition/pressing, country/year, condition, provenance, value, photos, purchase data, duplicates, and wishlist.

- Camera collection:
  - Owns or recently acquired a **1940s Leica IIIa** and a **1960s Nikon F**.
  - Wants to expand the collection with **vintage rangefinders** and is interested in notable brands/models, especially Leica, Nikon, Canon, Olympus, Contax, and Yashica. Previously suggested examples include Leica M3/M6/M7, Nikon SP/S2/S3, Canon VII and QL17 GIII, Olympus 35RC/35SP, Contax II/III, and Yashica Electro 35/Lynx; some are fixed-lens rather than interchangeable-lens rangefinders, so model/class distinctions matter.
  - Wants software for a vintage camera inventory, ideally supporting models, specifications, serial numbers, condition, provenance, repair/maintenance history, photos, accessories/lenses, purchase details, value, and customizable fields.
  - Interested in researching and verifying authenticity through manufacturer serial-number records, Leica/Nikon historical societies, reputable dealers or experts, auction records, and documentation.
  - For purchases, prioritize working condition, rust/corrosion/damage checks, lens quality, rarity, provenance, and fair market value. Arrange specialist cleaning/lubrication/adjustment only when appropriate.
  - Preserve cameras in a cool, dry, stable environment; do not oil, clean, or alter vintage mechanisms without specialist advice.
  - Also considers camera shows, antique shops, online marketplaces, and collector forums for potential purchases; coin shows are a secondary possibility because most offerings will focus on numismatics.

- General app-selection priorities:
  - Ease of use, useful fields, image/document storage, valuations, condition/provenance tracking, search/filtering, export/backup, cross-platform access, cost, privacy, and an active support/community.
  - User has not stated preferred operating system, region, budget, or whether cloud storage is acceptable.
